**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Server-only code cannot render JSX in a resumed route module: return data and render it in the page
```

## How to fix

Return plain data from serverLoad/onGet and render the JSX in the page component.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const serverLoad = () => ({ x: <p /> });
export default () => <p />;
```

```tsx prefer
export const serverLoad = () => ({ x: "text" });
export default () => <p />;
```

## When it is reported

serverExports + resume.
